thread:
maya: Quick midshift triage — snapshot for the shift: 42 open tickets (+8 since 06:00). Top things right now:
- Embeddings failures (api: /v1/embeddings) causing degraded QA scoring
- Duplicate billing webhook deliveries for a subset of customers
- Transient Dedicated timeouts in eu-west-1 on heavy seq lengths

I'm tagging owners and dropping two small macro suggestions below. Escalation: if embeddings error rate keeps rising >2% we'll open a runtime incident.

li: Thanks. I'll take embeddings. Any clear repro or spike window?

maya: Repro window 02:10–02:30 UTC. Logs show a burst of 429s coming from inference nodes after a cache miss cascade. Example trace id: trace=abc123def. Ticket 92412 is pinned: https://redwood.zendesk.com/agent/tickets/92412

juan: I'll loop in runtime oncall. @oliver fyi on possible kernel fallback issue.

oliver: Got it — can you paste the 24h error rate numbers? Also, do we want a short customer-facing acknowledgement macro to buy time?

maya: Last 24h: embeddings errors 0.3% baseline -> 1.2% peak in burst window (about ~200 failed requests). Proposed short macro 'embeddings-burst-ack' below for quick replies.

ben: I bumped the autoscale target for eu-west-1 from 5 -> 7 nodes to absorb the burst, monitoring for 10m. :thumbsup:

support-bot: autoscale-change recorded by ben at 2723456798

li: Macro text looks good. Suggest adding ETA + link to status page and a short troubleshooting step for devs if they want to escalate.

maya: Updated macro in repo — PR: https://github.com/redwood/support-macros/pull/456. Please review @juan @li. Also marking 92412 as claimed.

juan: Reviewing PR now. Also flag: yesterday's quantization rollout might be related; if error rate doesn't drop we should be ready to roll back that change (rollback candidate id: qz-deploy-2026-03-16).

oliver: If we need a rollback I'll coordinate, give me a 30m heads-up.

li: Operational note: when you claim a ticket for async handoff, prepend "CLAIMED:" to the subject and add the ETA. That makes rotation handoffs cleaner.

maya: Claimed now: 92412 (embeddings), 92418 (billing webhook dupes), 92420 (dedicated timeout).

ben: I also pushed a short billing-ack macro 'billing-duplicate-ack' to cover the most common duplicate-delivery questions. Snippet below.

maya: Please paste the macro snippets here so people can copy if needed.

ben: Macro: ```
Key: billing-duplicate-ack
Message: Hi — thanks for the report. We're seeing a subset of customers receiving duplicate billing webhook deliveries due to a transient retries loop. We're investigating and will follow up within 1 hour. If you can, please reply with the webhook id and sample payload. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai
```

maya: Embeddings macro (candidate): ```
Key: embeddings-burst-ack
Message: Thanks for reporting. We observed a short spike affecting embeddings generation; our engineers are actively investigating and we've scaled capacity. Expected next update within 30–60 minutes. If you can, please attach the request id or sample prompt. Trace id: abc123def
```

li: Small edit suggestion to the embeddings macro — add "If you need immediate refund/credit please let us know" line for billing-sensitive customers.

maya: Added that line in the PR. Juan/Oliver please review when you have a moment.

support-bot: Reminder: ticket 92418 has SLA 4h, 1h remaining as of 2723456832

juan: Noted. I'll take 92418 if that helps.

li: Thanks. Quick handoff: Maya -> Li at end of shift. If anything spikes, ping runtime oncall first and @support for paging.

maya: Handoff complete. End-of-shift notes: watch embeddings error rate (threshold 2%), billing dupes queue for high-touch customers, and the Dedicated timeouts in eu-west-1 while autoscale stabilizes.

support-bot: Handoff recorded: maya -> li at 2723456845

ben: Leaving a small bookmark: when replying to customers about embeddings failures, include the trace id and mention we've scaled nodes — helps reduce follow-ups.

oliver: Thanks all. I'll post updates here if we see any regression from the quantization deploy.

maya: Thanks team — please ack if you're monitoring something active. :eyes:
